en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a military officer in formal uniform adorned with medals. The officer is holding a coat over his left arm and standing outdoors, possibly in a garden or park. The style of the uniform and the officer's cap are characteristic of early 20th-century European military attire. French text is visible at the bottom, identifying the officer and the occasion.
